# Otopair

> Otopair is a trust-first automotive service marketplace that connects
> drivers with verified independent mechanic shops in Staten Island, NYC.
> Shops set their own prices; drivers see the full total before they
> confirm, a $20 hold reserves the slot, and the shop confirms the final
> price after inspection — it cannot exceed what the driver approved
> without in-app approval.

## Key facts

- Operator: AppFlow Creations Inc.
- Market: Staten Island, New York City (live). Brooklyn (Q4 2026), Queens (Q1 2027), The Bronx (Q2 2027) and Manhattan (Q3 2027) follow on the coverage timeline.
- Platforms: iOS and Android app for drivers (store listings on the way); web dashboard for shops.
- How it works: the driver describes the problem to Oto (the in-app assistant), picks a shop the Otopair team has approved, and sees the full total the shop set before confirming. A $20 hold reserves the slot; extra work needs the driver's approval in the app; funds are captured when the shop marks the job complete.
- Cost to shops: no subscription, no setup fee.
- Payments: Stripe Connect. Shops are paid through Stripe on Stripe's payout schedule.
- Services: 22 bookable services across 4 categories (Routine, Tires & Brakes, Scheduled Service, Inspections). Prices are built per vehicle in the app; no averages are published.
- Verification: a shop is listed after a manual review and approval by the Otopair team, a connected Stripe account, published hours, at least one mechanic and one service. Otopair does not certify licences or insurance.
- Reviews: one-way, from drivers with a completed booking only.
- Support: support@otopair.com
